736:t_1:166.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Isn't that in pretty poor taste, $$クルツ$$?」

736:t_1:167.en:
$$宗介$$
「Leave him alone. He's an unfortunate man who can only live in the middle of a war.」

736:t_1:168.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I never thought the day would come when you'd say a line like that to me.」

736:t_1:169.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Right. Even I'm a little surprised.」

736:t_1:170.en:
$$カレン$$
「A woman's presence changes a man.」

736:t_1:171.en:
$$かなめ$$
「W-What do you mean, $$カレン$$...」

736:t_1:172.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「...The fact is, the turmoil on Earth won't settle down that easily.」

736:t_1:173.en:
$$マオ$$
「$c will probably be disbanded once we get back to Earth, too. And on top of that, $$ミスリル$$ itself is in a state of collapse.」

736:t_1:174.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「So, $$ゼロ$$... If it suits you, why don't you come to $$ミスリル$$?」

736:t_1:176.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$テッサ$$ said things would get a little easier for her if you joined, $$ゼロ$$.」

736:t_1:177.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$テッサ$$ complains to us that she wants to go back to being an ordinary girl, after all.」

736:t_1:179.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Having skeletons in your closet is a common story in the mercenary world.」

736:t_1:180.en:
$$マオ$$
「With $$宗介$$ leaving, we have to bring in replacements to make up for the lost firepower.」

736:t_1:182.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Well... we'll talk about that once this is over.」

736:t_1:183.en:
$$クルツ$$
「But hey, $$宗介$$... You're the one who decides how you live, by your own will.」

736:t_1:184.en:
$$マオ$$
「Whatever your answer is, we intend to accept it.」

736:t_1:186.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「$$キリコ$$... Naturally, you'll join $$ミスリル$$, won't you?」

736:t_1:188.en:
$$マオ$$
「Hold it right there! That would completely wreck our plans!」

736:t_1:189.en:
$$カレン$$
「So you were planning to fill $$宗介$$'s gap with $$キリコ$$...」

736:t_1:190.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Seriously, $$キリコ$$!? Have you already signed with some mercenary company!?」

736:t_1:192.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$キリコ$$ will not fight anymore, I take it.」

736:t_1:194.en:
$$カレン$$
「Living together with $$フィアナ$$... That's the life $$キリコ$$ chose, isn't it.」

736:t_1:195.en:
$$宗介$$
「If that's the answer he chose, no one can move him anymore.」

736:t_1:196.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Um, hey... $$宗介$$... It's great that you're feeling free, but aren't we maybe in danger of not graduating?」

736:t_1:198.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「This is terrible, $$正太郎$$! What are we going to do if we can't graduate either!?」

736:t_1:199.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Calm down, $$ワッ太$$. If you did the homework Miss $$美重子$$ gave out when the Galactic Raid Fleet set off, you'll be fine.」

736:t_1:200.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Th-then...! If we didn't do it...」

736:t_1:202.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That's exactly how it is, I'm afraid...」

736:t_1:203.en:
$$柿小路$$
「This is no laughing matter, President!」

736:t_1:204.en:
$$厚井$$
「True, we had no time to get the homework out of the way, but...」

736:t_1:205.en:
$$郁絵$$
「But if $$正太郎$$ did his, we can't make excuses.」

736:t_1:206.en:
$$木下$$
「To think the President would stay an elementary school president forever...」

736:t_1:207.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「No way, not that! I want to graduate with $$かおる$$-chan and $$正太郎$$ and everyone too!」

736:t_1:208.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't push yourself, $$ワッ太$$. The way you are now, you'd never keep up with middle school studies anyway.」

736:t_1:210.en:
$$恵子$$
「Stop making $$ワッ太$$ anxious like that...!」

736:t_1:211.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Isn't there some way...? Like, you know... $$真化融合$$ with the homework, and suddenly I just know all the answers...」

736:t_1:212.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Of course not. The homework's heart of justice would oppose a cheat like that.」

736:t_1:214.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It's because $$グーラ$$ has come to have a heart that won't tolerate evil by fighting alongside us.」

736:t_1:215.en:
$$グーラ$$
「$$ワッ太$$... If you have a heart of justice, then take on your homework fair and square.」

736:t_1:216.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「If you're going to say that much, then $$竹尾ワッ太$$, a real man, can't back down!」

736:t_1:217.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Before the big showdown for humanity's future, I'll knock out my homework in a flash!」

736:t_1:218.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Good luck, $$ワッ太$$. I'll help with the parts you don't understand.」

736:t_1:220.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...At this rate, the great collapse of the universe will come first...」

736:t_1:221.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I won't let that happen! I'll do it all, the fighting and the homework!」

736:t_1:222.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Elementary school kids have it hard in their own way, huh.」

736:t_1:223.en:
$$青山$$
「Even things that seem trivial to us adults are a big deal to them.」

736:t_1:224.en:
$$赤木$$
「But adults have it hard too. Even after the universe is at peace, disasters will surely still happen... We have to prepare for them.」

736:t_1:225.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Isn't that getting a little ahead of yourself?」

736:t_1:226.en:
$$青山$$
「She's right. Our next opponent has power on a completely different scale from anything so far, after all.」

736:t_1:227.en:
$$赤木$$
「It'll be fine! No... I'll make it fine!」

736:t_1:228.en:
$$赤木$$
「I bet when we're old and looking back on our youth, even the next battle will be at the level of 'oh yeah, that happened too.'」

736:t_1:229.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「I'm sick of it, knowing there will be battles like this again and again...」

736:t_1:230.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But life goes on. The Show Must Go On.」

736:t_1:231.en:
$$赤木$$
「What do you say, $$ロジャー$$? Want to put your negotiating skills to use at $$２１世紀警備保障$$?」

736:t_1:232.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A headhunting offer, is it? I'm not displeased to have my work appreciated.」

736:t_1:233.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$ロジャー$$... What about our plan for you to become a private detective with me?」

736:t_1:234.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You invited me as well, $$万丈$$. Neither is a bad offer.」

736:t_1:235.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Which one do you intend to pick?」

736:t_1:236.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I don't intend to give an answer here.」

736:t_1:237.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Not confident you'll make it back?」

736:t_1:238.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's not it. I simply want to enjoy to the fullest the possibilities spreading out before me... freedom, you might call it.」

736:t_1:239.en:
$$万丈$$
「The fight against those who would block that freedom... We'll win the future, you'll see.」

736:t_1:240.en:
$$ランカ$$
「We're going to the $$バジュラ$$ planet, aren't we?」

736:t_1:241.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Right. That planet is an Earth-type planet, and the $$フロンティア船団$$, as its first discoverer, has the right to settle there.」

736:t_1:242.en:
$$アルト$$
「So our journey is about to end...」

736:t_1:243.en:
$$オズマ$$
「But that comes after we get through the crisis the universe is facing.」

736:t_1:244.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「The $$御使い$$... and the great collapse of the universe...」

736:t_1:245.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「The immortal $$御使い$$s alone are trouble enough, and we still don't even know how to stop the great collapse...」
